subject: Health and Physical Education
description: Health and Physical Education complete progression map — 6 year levels, 97 standards, 2 strands. Merged from 2 source files.

standards.title: Who they are and their world
standards.description: investigate who they are and the people in their world
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students investigate who they are and the people in their world.

standards.title: Personal and social skills
standards.description: practise personal and social skills to interact respectfully with others
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students practise personal and social skills to interact respectfully with others.

standards.title: Express emotions
standards.description: express and describe emotions they experience
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students express and describe emotions they experience.

standards.title: Seek, give or deny permission
standards.description: explore how to seek, give or deny permission respectfully when sharing possessions or personal space
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students explore how to seek, give or deny permission respectfully.

standards.title: Protective behaviours and help-seeking
standards.description: demonstrate protective behaviours, name body parts and rehearse help-seeking strategies that help keep them safe
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students demonstrate protective behaviours and rehearse help-seeking strategies.

standards.title: Health symbols and messages
standards.description: identify health symbols, messages and strategies in their community that support their health and safety
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students identify health symbols, messages and strategies that support their health and safety.

standards.title: Fundamental movement skills
standards.description: practise fundamental movement skills in minor game and play situations
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students practise fundamental movement skills in minor game and play situations.

standards.title: Moving body and manipulating objects
standards.description: experiment with different ways of moving their body safely and manipulating objects and space
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students experiment with different ways of moving their body safely and manipulating objects and space.

standards.title: Physical activity benefits
standards.description: participate in a range of activities in natural and outdoor settings and explore the benefits of being physically active
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students participate in activities in natural and outdoor settings and explore the benefits of physical activity.

standards.title: Fair play rules
standards.description: follow rules to promote fair play in a range of physical activities
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students follow rules to promote fair play in a range of physical activities.

standards.title: Personal qualities and identities
standards.description: describe their personal qualities and those of others, and explain how they contribute to developing identities
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students describe personal qualities and explain how they contribute to developing identities.

standards.title: Respectful relationships
standards.description: identify and explore skills and strategies to develop respectful relationships
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students identify and explore skills and strategies to develop respectful relationships.

standards.title: Emotional responses
standards.description: identify how different situations influence emotional responses
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students identify how different situations influence emotional responses.

standards.title: Seek, give or deny permission
standards.description: practise strategies they can use when they need to seek, give or deny permission respectfully
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students practise strategies for seeking, giving or denying permission respectfully.

standards.title: Protective behaviours and help-seeking
standards.description: identify and demonstrate protective behaviours and help-seeking strategies they can use to help them and others stay safe
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students identify and demonstrate protective behaviours and help-seeking strategies.

standards.title: Health messages in community
standards.description: investigate a range of health messages and practices in their community and discuss their purposes
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students investigate health messages and practices in their community and discuss their purposes.

standards.title: Fundamental movement in varied situations
standards.description: practise fundamental movement skills and apply them in a variety of movement situations
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students practise fundamental movement skills and apply them in a variety of movement situations.

standards.title: Moving and manipulating objects
standards.description: investigate different ways of moving their body, and manipulating objects and space, and draw conclusions about their effectiveness
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students investigate different ways of moving and manipulating objects and draw conclusions about effectiveness.

standards.title: Physical activity enjoyment
standards.description: participate in a range of physical activities in natural and outdoor settings, and investigate factors and settings that make physical activity enjoyable
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students participate in physical activities in natural settings and investigate factors that make activity enjoyable.

standards.title: Co-construct fair play rules
standards.description: co-construct and apply rules to promote fair play in a range of physical activities
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students co-construct and apply rules to promote fair play.

standards.title: Collaborative participation
standards.description: apply strategies to work collaboratively when participating in physical activities
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students apply strategies to work collaboratively in physical activities.

standards.title: Resilience and identities
standards.description: investigate how success, challenge, setbacks and failure strengthen resilience and identities in a range of contexts
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students investigate how success, challenge, setbacks and failure strengthen resilience and identities.

standards.title: Coping with changes and transitions
standards.description: plan, rehearse and reflect on strategies to cope with the different changes and transitions they experience
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students plan, rehearse and reflect on strategies to cope with changes and transitions including puberty.

standards.title: Stereotypes and choices
standards.description: describe how choices and actions can be influenced by stereotypes
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students describe how choices and actions can be influenced by stereotypes.

standards.title: Personal and social skills in relationships
standards.description: select, use and refine personal and social skills to establish, manage and strengthen relationships
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students select, use and refine personal and social skills to establish and strengthen relationships.

standards.title: Diversity and inclusion
standards.description: describe how valuing diversity influences wellbeing and identify actions that promote inclusion in their communities
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students describe how valuing diversity influences wellbeing and identify actions promoting inclusion.

standards.title: Managing emotions
standards.description: explain how and why emotional responses can vary and practise strategies to manage their emotions
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students explain how emotional responses vary and practise strategies to manage emotions.

standards.title: Consent strategies
standards.description: rehearse and refine strategies for seeking, giving and denying permission respectfully and describe situations when permission is required
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students rehearse strategies for seeking, giving and denying permission respectfully.

standards.title: Protective behaviours online and offline
standards.description: describe and apply protective behaviours and help-seeking strategies in a range of online and offline situations
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students describe and apply protective behaviours and help-seeking strategies in online and offline situations.

standards.title: Health information and decisions
standards.description: interpret the nature and intention of health information and messages, and reflect on how they influence personal decisions and behaviours
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students interpret health information and messages and reflect on how they influence decisions.

standards.title: Health and wellbeing behaviours
standards.description: investigate and apply behaviours that contribute to their own and others' health, safety, relationships and wellbeing
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students investigate and apply behaviours contributing to health, safety, relationships and wellbeing.

standards.title: Refine movement skills
standards.description: refine and apply fundamental movement skills in new movement situations
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students refine and apply fundamental movement skills in new movement situations.

standards.title: Movement strategies
standards.description: apply and adapt movement strategies to achieve movement outcomes
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students apply and adapt movement strategies to achieve movement outcomes.

standards.title: Movement concepts
standards.description: demonstrate how movement concepts related to effort, space, time, objects and people can be applied when performing movement sequences
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students demonstrate how movement concepts can be applied when performing movement sequences.

standards.title: Regular physical activity and health
standards.description: participate in physical activities to explore how their body feels and describe how regular physical activity helps the body stay healthy and well
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students participate in physical activities and describe how regular activity supports health and wellbeing.

standards.title: Outdoor physical activity
standards.description: participate in physical activities in natural and outdoor settings to examine factors that can influence their own and others' participation
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students participate in outdoor physical activities and examine factors influencing participation.

standards.title: Physical activity recommendations
standards.description: explore recommendations about physical activity and sedentary behaviours, and discuss strategies to achieve the recommendations
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students explore physical activity recommendations and discuss strategies to achieve them.

standards.title: Creative movement design
standards.description: apply creative thinking when designing movement sequences and solving movement problems
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students apply creative thinking when designing movement sequences and solving movement problems.

standards.title: Rules and fair play
standards.description: apply rules and scoring systems to promote fair play when participating or designing physical activities
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students apply rules and scoring systems to promote fair play in physical activities.

standards.title: Group roles and teamwork
standards.description: perform a range of roles in respectful ways to achieve successful outcomes in group or team movement activities
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students perform a range of roles respectfully to achieve successful outcomes in group movement activities.

standards.title: Identities and self-concept
standards.description: explain how identities can be influenced by people and places, and how we can create positive self-identities
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students explain how identities are influenced by people and places and how positive self-identities can be created.

standards.title: Managing changes and transitions
standards.description: investigate resources and strategies to manage changes and transitions, including changes associated with puberty
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students investigate resources and strategies to manage changes and transitions including puberty.

standards.title: Gender stereotypes
standards.description: investigate how the portrayal of societal roles and responsibilities can be influenced by gender stereotypes
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students investigate how the portrayal of societal roles can be influenced by gender stereotypes.

standards.title: Respect and empathy
standards.description: describe and demonstrate how respect and empathy can be expressed to positively influence relationships
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students describe and demonstrate how respect and empathy positively influence relationships.

standards.title: Valuing diversity
standards.description: describe and implement strategies to value diversity in their communities
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students describe and implement strategies to value diversity in their communities.

standards.title: Emotional responses and interactions
standards.description: apply strategies to manage emotions and analyse how emotional responses influence interactions
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students apply strategies to manage emotions and analyse how emotional responses influence interactions.

standards.title: Consent communication
standards.description: describe strategies for seeking, giving or denying consent and rehearse how to communicate their intentions effectively and respectfully
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students describe consent strategies and rehearse communicating intentions effectively and respectfully.

standards.title: Protective behaviours analysis
standards.description: analyse and rehearse protective behaviours and help-seeking strategies that can be used in a range of online and offline situations
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students analyse and rehearse protective behaviours and help-seeking strategies for online and offline situations.

standards.title: Health information sources
standards.description: investigate different sources and types of health information and how these apply to their own and others' health choices
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students investigate different sources of health information and how they apply to health choices.

standards.title: Behaviours and community health
standards.description: analyse how behaviours influence the health, safety, relationships and wellbeing of individuals and communities
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students analyse how behaviours influence the health, safety, relationships and wellbeing of individuals and communities.

standards.title: Adapt movement skills
standards.description: adapt and modify movement skills across a variety of situations
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students adapt and modify movement skills across a variety of situations.

standards.title: Transfer movement strategies
standards.description: transfer familiar movement strategies to different movement situations
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students transfer familiar movement strategies to different movement situations.

standards.title: Movement concepts to improve outcomes
standards.description: investigate how different movement concepts related to effort, space, time, objects and people can be applied to improve movement outcomes
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students investigate how movement concepts can be applied to improve movement outcomes.

standards.title: Body's reaction to intensity
standards.description: participate in physical activities to investigate the body's reaction to different levels of intensity
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students participate in physical activities and investigate the body's reaction to different intensity levels.

standards.title: Health and wellbeing in outdoor settings
standards.description: participate in physical activities that enhance health and wellbeing in natural and outdoor settings, and analyse the steps and resources needed to promote participation
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students participate in outdoor physical activities and analyse steps and resources needed to promote participation.

standards.title: Strategies to increase activity
standards.description: propose and explain strategies to increase physical activity and reduce sedentary behaviour levels in their lives
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students propose and explain strategies to increase physical activity and reduce sedentary behaviour.

standards.title: Test movement effectiveness
standards.description: predict and test the effectiveness of applying different skills and strategies in a range of movement situations
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students predict and test the effectiveness of different skills and strategies in movement situations.

standards.title: Game modifications for inclusion
standards.description: devise and test alternative rules and game modifications to support fair play and inclusive participation
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students devise and test alternative rules and game modifications to support fair play and inclusion.

standards.title: Group participation and negotiation
standards.description: participate positively in groups and teams by contributing to group activities, encouraging others and negotiating roles and responsibilities
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students participate positively in groups by contributing, encouraging others and negotiating roles.

standards.title: Values, beliefs and identities
standards.description: analyse and reflect on the influence of values and beliefs on the development of identities
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students analyse and reflect on the influence of values and beliefs on the development of identities.

standards.title: Changes, transitions and support
standards.description: analyse the impact of changes and transitions, and devise strategies to support themselves and others through these changes
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students analyse the impact of changes and transitions and devise strategies to support themselves and others.

standards.title: Gender, power and relationships
standards.description: examine how roles, decision-making, and levels of power, coercion and control within relationships can be influenced by gender stereotypes
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students examine how power, coercion and gender stereotypes influence roles and relationships.

standards.title: Respectful relationships
standards.description: examine the roles of respect, empathy, power and coercion in developing respectful relationships
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students examine the roles of respect, empathy, power and coercion in developing respectful relationships.

standards.title: Community diversity and inclusion
standards.description: investigate strategies that influence how communities value diversity and propose actions they can take to promote inclusion in their communities
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students investigate diversity strategies and propose actions to promote inclusion in their communities.

standards.title: Emotional self-management
standards.description: analyse factors that influence emotional responses and devise strategies to self-manage emotions
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students analyse factors influencing emotional responses and devise self-management strategies.

standards.title: Assertive consent communication
standards.description: explain and apply skills and strategies to communicate assertively and respectfully when seeking, giving or denying consent
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students explain and apply skills to communicate assertively when seeking, giving or denying consent.

standards.title: Protective behaviours and community resources
standards.description: refine protective behaviours and evaluate community resources to seek help for themselves and others
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students refine protective behaviours and evaluate community resources for help-seeking.

standards.title: Media influence on health
standards.description: investigate how media and influential people impact attitudes, beliefs, decisions and behaviours in relation to health, safety, relationships and wellbeing
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students investigate how media and influential people impact health attitudes, beliefs and behaviours.

standards.title: Health strategies and resources
standards.description: plan and implement strategies, using health resources, to enhance their own and others' health, safety, relationships and wellbeing
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students plan and implement strategies using health resources to enhance health, safety and wellbeing.

standards.title: Analyse and transfer movement skills
standards.description: analyse, refine and transfer movement skills in a variety of movement situations
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students analyse, refine and transfer movement skills in a variety of movement situations.

standards.title: Design movement strategies
standards.description: design and demonstrate how movement strategies can be manipulated to improve movement outcomes
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students design and demonstrate how movement strategies can be manipulated to improve outcomes.

standards.title: Manipulate movement concepts
standards.description: demonstrate and explain how movement concepts related to effort, space, time, objects and people can be manipulated to improve movement outcomes
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students demonstrate and explain how movement concepts can be manipulated to improve movement outcomes.

standards.title: Fitness and health participation
standards.description: participate in physical activities designed to improve fitness and wellbeing to investigate the impact of regular participation on health, fitness and wellbeing
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students participate in fitness activities and investigate the impact of regular participation on health and wellbeing.

standards.title: Community spaces and outdoor settings
standards.description: participate in physical activities that utilise community spaces and outdoor settings, and evaluate strategies to support increased use of these spaces
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students participate in activities in community and outdoor settings and evaluate strategies to increase their use.

standards.title: Design physical activity strategies
standards.description: design and justify strategies to increase physical activity levels to achieve health and wellbeing outcomes
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students design and justify strategies to increase physical activity to achieve health and wellbeing outcomes.

standards.title: Evaluate movement strategies
standards.description: propose and evaluate movement strategies and skills that would be most effective in different movement situations
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students propose and evaluate movement strategies and skills for different movement situations.

standards.title: Modifications for inclusion
standards.description: investigate modifications to equipment, rules and scoring systems that support fair play and inclusive participation
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students investigate modifications to equipment, rules and scoring systems supporting fair play and inclusion.

standards.title: Leadership and collaboration
standards.description: practise and apply leadership, collaboration and group decision-making processes when participating in a range of physical activities
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students practise and apply leadership, collaboration and group decision-making in physical activities.

standards.title: Factors shaping identities
standards.description: analyse factors that shape identities and evaluate how individuals influence the identities of others
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students analyse factors that shape identities and evaluate how individuals influence others' identities.

standards.title: Managing changes and transitions
standards.description: refine, evaluate and adapt strategies for managing changes and transitions
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students refine, evaluate and adapt strategies for managing changes and transitions.

standards.title: Gender equality and violence prevention
standards.description: investigate how gender equality and challenging assumptions about gender can prevent violence and abuse in relationships
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students investigate how gender equality and challenging gender assumptions can prevent violence in relationships.

standards.title: Evaluating respectful relationships
standards.description: evaluate the influence of respect, empathy, power and coercion on establishing and maintaining respectful relationships
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students evaluate the influence of respect, empathy, power and coercion on respectful relationships.

standards.title: Challenging bias and promoting inclusion
standards.description: propose strategies and actions individuals and groups can implement to challenge biases, stereotypes, prejudices and discrimination, and promote inclusion in their communities
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students propose strategies to challenge biases, stereotypes and discrimination and promote inclusion.

standards.title: Evaluating emotional responses
standards.description: evaluate emotional responses in different situations to refine strategies for managing emotions
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students evaluate emotional responses in different situations to refine emotion management strategies.

standards.title: Consent and respectful relationships
standards.description: examine how strategies, such as communicating choices, seeking, giving and denying consent, and expressing opinions and needs can support the development of respectful relationships, including sexual relationships
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students examine how consent communication strategies support respectful relationships including sexual relationships.

standards.title: Managing health risk situations
standards.description: plan, rehearse and evaluate strategies for managing situations where their own or others' health, safety or wellbeing may be at risk
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students plan, rehearse and evaluate strategies for managing health and safety risk situations.

standards.title: Critique health information and media
standards.description: critique health information, services and media messaging about relationships, lifestyle choices, health decisions and behaviours to evaluate their influence on individual attitudes and actions
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students critique health information and media messaging to evaluate their influence on attitudes and actions.

standards.title: Plan and critique health strategies
standards.description: plan, justify and critique strategies to enhance their own and others' health, safety, relationships and wellbeing
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students plan, justify and critique strategies to enhance health, safety, relationships and wellbeing.

standards.title: Analyse and enhance performance
standards.description: analyse, adapt and refine their own and others' movement skills in a range of challenging movement situations to enhance performance
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students analyse, adapt and refine movement skills in challenging situations to enhance performance.

standards.title: Create movement strategies
standards.description: create and refine movement strategies to achieve successful outcomes across a range of challenging movement situations
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students create and refine movement strategies to achieve successful outcomes in challenging situations.

standards.title: Apply movement concepts
standards.description: apply movement concepts in new or challenging movement situations and analyse the impact each concept has on movement outcomes
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students apply movement concepts in new situations and analyse their impact on movement outcomes.

standards.title: Design personalised activity plans
standards.description: participate in physical activities designed to enhance health, wellbeing and fitness, and design, apply and evaluate strategies for incorporating these activities into their lives
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students design, apply and evaluate personalised strategies for incorporating physical activity into their lives.

standards.title: Health and social outcomes
standards.description: participate in physical activities that promote health and social outcomes to design and evaluate participation strategies for themselves and others
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students participate in activities promoting health and social outcomes and design participation strategies.

standards.title: Personalised physical activity plans
standards.description: design, implement and evaluate personalised plans for improving or maintaining their own or others' physical activity levels to achieve fitness, health and wellbeing outcomes
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students design, implement and evaluate personalised physical activity plans to achieve fitness and wellbeing outcomes.

standards.title: Transfer skills to unfamiliar situations
standards.description: transfer and adapt skills and strategies from previous experiences to create successful outcomes in unfamiliar movement situations
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students transfer and adapt skills from previous experiences to create successful outcomes in unfamiliar situations.

standards.title: Fair play and ethical behaviour
standards.description: demonstrate fair play and reflect on how ethical behaviour can influence physical activity outcomes for individuals and groups
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students demonstrate fair play and reflect on how ethical behaviour influences outcomes for individuals and groups.

standards.title: Leadership and decision-making
standards.description: devise, implement and refine strategies for decision-making when working in groups or teams that demonstrate leadership and collaboration skills
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students devise, implement and refine decision-making strategies demonstrating leadership and collaboration.

progression_threads.description: All strands across Health and Physical Education.
